02 Publish

Before publication

Please share the following items for a quick factual review. The review is only intended to check product names, specifications, links, and other factual information.

  • Unlisted video link or draft
  • Product link and discount code placement
  • The review is only intended to check product names, specifications, links, and other factual information :)
If you would like, you can also send your proposed title, thumbnail, or description text. This helps us catch factual issues early, but your creative voice remains your own.
Description placement tip
Links can be hidden behind YouTube’s “more” button. Whenever possible, place your SO-ARM101 affiliate product link at the beginning of the video description.
03 Guide

Publishing guidelines

Use these simple guidelines to make your product link easier to find and your description easier for viewers to follow.

Description guidance

Links in the description can sometimes be hidden behind the “more” button, so viewers may not immediately notice there’s a product link. Please place your SO-ARM101 affiliate product link as close to the beginning of the description as possible.

For Shorts, you can also add a simple CTA such as “Get the link in the description.”

#seeedstudio #opensource #huggingface #3dprinting
Disclosure note

Please disclose gifted products, sponsorships, or affiliate relationships in accordance with applicable advertising guidelines and platform policies. This helps keep your content transparent and compliant.

Suggested approach: if the product was provided by Seeed Studio, or you use affiliate links and earn a commission, make that relationship clear somewhere in the video and/or description.

How to Join the Seeed Studio Affiliate Program

Follow these steps to create your account, complete your affiliate profile, generate a trackable referral link, and monitor clicks and commissions.

Step 1: Create Your Seeed Studio Account

1. Create or Sign In to Your Account. Create a Seeed Studio account or sign in ↗

2. Open the Affiliate Account Dashboard. After signing in, select My Account → Affiliate Account.

Step 2: Complete Your Affiliate Profile

Enter the required details under Affiliate Settings, then select Save.

  • Referring Website: Add your main promotion channel, such as YouTube, a blog, Instagram, or another social platform. This field is optional.
  • PayPal Email: Enter the PayPal email you want to use for commission payments.
Most important step

Step 3: Generate Your Referral Link

1. Choose a Product. Open the official SO-ARM101 product page and copy the page URL.

SO-ARM101 Pro Assembled Kit Product Page ↗

2. Create the Tracking Link.

  1. Under Affiliate Account, select Promo Data.
  2. Paste the product page URL into the Referral Link field.
  3. Select Copy to copy your unique referral link.
  4. Share the generated referral link in your content.
Important: Always share the generated referral link, not the original product URL. This allows clicks and orders to be attributed to your affiliate account.

Open Promo Data / Affiliate Dashboard ↗

How to Check Your Earnings and Balance

Under Affiliate Account, select My Balance to review your Balance, Available, On Hold, Lifetime, and Paid amounts. To request a payout, select My Withdrawals.

How to Check Link Clicks

Under Affiliate Account, select Traffic Sources. The Count column shows recorded clicks by source.

Program Details

  • Commission: Our standard commission starts at 3% on eligible products. For SO-ARM101 robotic arm collaborations, the special commission is 5%, subject to the agreed offer and program terms.
  • Tracking: You will receive your own affiliate links, with a stated 45-day cookie tracking window. You can monitor your referrals and commissions through your affiliate dashboard.
  • Payouts: The minimum withdrawal amount is $50. Payments are processed quarterly, and you can request a withdrawal through your affiliate account.

Once you complete the registration, please share the email address you used to sign up with your Seeed Studio contact. We will then help confirm your account and support you with your affiliate link, discount code, and any product information you may need for your content.
